name: Palm Sunday
overview: Palm Sunday commemorates the triumphant entry of Jesus into Jerusalem, fulfilling the prophecy of Zechariah 9:9 and Matthew 21:5 that the Messiah would come humbly, riding on a donkey. This event, recorded in Matthew 21:1 and Mark 11:1, marks the arrival of the King who brings salvation and peace. The people's joyful reception, symbolized by waving palm branches, echoes the cry for salvation found in Psalms 118:25. Ultimately, this day points to the necessity of faith in Christ, as emphasized in Mark 16:16, affirming that belief in Jesus is the pathway to salvation.
